title: Senior Python Engineer | 4+ Years Experience | Flask/FastAPI | Docker | AWS
meta_description: We're hiring a Senior Python Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Flask/FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD & cloud (AWS/Azure). Lead modules & mentor juniors.
clean_text:
Senior Python Engineer
Experience : 4+ years
No of opening - 1
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer who can own and deliver full modules, work independently, and guide junior team members. You’ll be expected to participate in technical solutioning and client discussions when required.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy Python applications and modules.
Take ownership of modules/features.
Support senior engineers and deliver high-quality code.
Mentor junior engineers — code review, debugging, guidance.
Join client calls to clarify or present solutions.
Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code.
Use GenAI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to improve efficiency.
Debug and upgrade existing modules.
Follow Git and CI/CD best practices.
Requirements
4+ years in Python development.
Strong in OOPs, core Python, and design patterns.
Flask/FastAPI framework experience.
REST APIs and RDBMS (PostgreSQL/MySQL).
Git, code reviews, and Agile methodology.
Experience with GenAI tools for dev productivity.
Docker and Docker Compose; Kubernetes is a bonus.
Basic understanding of AWS (VPC, EC2, ECS, Lambda, etc.) or Azure (VMs, AKS, etc.).
CI/CD understanding and debugging deployment issues.
Growth & Team Expectation:
Lead sub-modules and support associates.
Report to experienced engineers on larger projects.
Opportunity to grow into a technical leadership role.
Soft Skills:
Ownership mindset and proactive approach.
Strong communication with clients and team.
Collaborative and reliable team player.
HR Department
At Sculptsoft, we’re always on the lookout for talented professionals to join our team. Submit your resume and take the first step toward an exciting career with us.
